pipeline_json.name: pharmacy_ods
pipeline_json.description: Silver raw to silver ODS — pharmacy_claim only. Same enrollment pattern as claim_header; patient_sk = cinq_id.

queries.result_inserts:
SELECT * FROM (-- CDC enrichment for silver_ods.pharmacy_claim via member enrollment
WITH raw_batch AS (
  SELECT r.*, p.mbi_id,
    sha2(concat_ws('||',
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.source_claim_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(cast(r.line_number as string), '1')
    ), 256) AS business_key_hash,
    sha2(concat_ws('||',
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_type as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.external_claim_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.replaced_claim_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_adjustment_type_cd as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_received_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.primary_payer_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.primary_payer as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_effective_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_status as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.denial_reason as string)), ''),
      coalesce(cast(r.quantity_units as string), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.prescription_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.filled_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.service_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.ndc_code as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.source_drug_code as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.source_code_system as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.product as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.quantity as string)), ''),
      coalesce(cast(r.days_supply as string), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.prescriber_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.prescriber_npi as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.dispensing_facility_id as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.line_charge as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.allowed_amount as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.plan_paid_amount as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.member_responsibility as string)), '')
    ), 256) AS ods_record_hash
  FROM ${catalog}.${raw_schema}.pharmacy_claim r
  INNER JOIN ${catalog}.${raw_schema}.patient p
    ON coalesce(r.source_member_id, r.patient_id) = p.source_member_id
   AND r.source_system = p.source_system
  WHERE r.batch_id = '${batch_id}'
),
enrollment_match AS (
  SELECT mes.cinq_id, mes.insurance_id, r.patient_id, r.source_member_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY coalesce(r.source_member_id, r.patient_id), mes.insurance_id, mes.cinq_id
      ORDER BY mes.batch_id DESC
    ) AS dup_seq
  FROM ${enrollment_catalog}.${enrollment_schema}.members_enrollment_segments mes
  INNER JOIN raw_batch r ON mes.insurance_id = r.mbi_id
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT
    r.batch_id, r.record_hash, r.is_deleted, r.ods_record_hash, r.is_active,
    r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, r.source_system, r.business_key_hash,
    r.silver_id, r.source_claim_id, r.claim_type, r.external_claim_id, r.replaced_claim_id,
    r.claim_adjustment_type_cd, r.claim_received_date, r.patient_id, r.source_member_id,
    r.primary_payer_id, r.primary_payer, r.claim_effective_date, r.claim_status, r.denial_reason,
    r.quantity_units, r.line_number, r.prescription_date, r.filled_date, r.service_date,
    r.ndc_code, cast(null as string) AS ndc_code_desc, r.source_drug_code, r.source_code_system,
    r.product, r.quantity, r.days_supply, r.prescriber_id, r.prescriber_npi, r.dispensing_facility_id,
    r.line_charge, r.allowed_amount, r.plan_paid_amount, r.member_responsibility,
    mes.cinq_id AS patient_sk
  FROM raw_batch r
  INNER JOIN enrollment_match mes
    ON coalesce(r.source_member_id, r.patient_id) = coalesce(mes.source_member_id, mes.patient_id)
   AND mes.dup_seq = 1
),
with_ods AS (
  SELECT
    e.batch_id, e.record_hash, e.is_deleted, e.ods_record_hash, e.is_active,
    e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_by, e.updated_at, e.source_system, e.business_key_hash,
    e.silver_id, e.source_claim_id, e.claim_type, e.external_claim_id, e.replaced_claim_id,
    e.claim_adjustment_type_cd, e.claim_received_date, e.patient_id, e.source_member_id,
    e.primary_payer_id, e.primary_payer, e.claim_effective_date, e.claim_status, e.denial_reason,
    e.quantity_units, e.line_number, e.prescription_date, e.filled_date, e.service_date,
    e.ndc_code, coalesce(o.ndc_code_desc, e.ndc_code_desc) AS ndc_code_desc,
    e.source_drug_code, e.source_code_system, e.product, e.quantity, e.days_supply,
    e.prescriber_id, e.prescriber_npi, e.dispensing_facility_id,
    e.line_charge, e.allowed_amount, e.plan_paid_amount, e.member_responsibility,
    coalesce(o.pharmacy_claim_sk, uuid()) AS pharmacy_claim_sk,
    coalesce(o.patient_sk, e.patient_sk) AS patient_sk,
    CASE
      WHEN o.pharmacy_claim_sk IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
      WHEN coalesce(e.is_active, true) = false AND coalesce(o.is_active, true) = true THEN 'DELETE'
      WHEN coalesce(e.is_active, true) = true AND coalesce(o.is_active, true) = false THEN 'UPDATE'
      WHEN coalesce(e.record_hash, '') <> coalesce(o.record_hash, '') THEN 'UPDATE'
      WHEN coalesce(e.ods_record_hash, '') <> coalesce(o.ods_record_hash, '') THEN 'UPDATE'
      ELSE 'NOOP'
    END AS cdc_action
  FROM enriched e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.business_key_hash
        ORDER BY coalesce(o.updated_at, o.created_at) DESC, o.batch_id DESC
      ) AS dup_seq
    FROM ${catalog}.${ods_schema}.pharmacy_claim o
    WHERE coalesce(o.is_active, true) = true
  ) o
    ON o.business_key_hash = e.business_key_hash
   AND o.dup_seq = 1
)
SELECT * FROM with_ods WHERE cdc_action <> 'NOOP'
) x WHERE cdc_action = 'INSERT'
